title: Southwest Kansas ICE Operations & Meatpacking Town Resistance
summary: Late September 2026 federal immigration enforcement deployment in Dodge City and Garden City, KS. Triggered widespread commercial walkouts, residential vehicle tracking via citizen video, and town-hall protests highlighting meatpacking industry disruption and community mutual aid.

milestones.headline: Citizen Alerts on Residential ICE Patrols
milestones.description: TikTok and Facebook users begin live-documenting unmarked federal law enforcement vehicles roaming neighborhood streets.
milestones.author: catrachito-mena

milestones.headline: Dodge City Town Square Mass Demonstration
milestones.description: Hundreds of residents gather in central Dodge City holding Mexican and American flags, protesting workplace detentions.
milestones.author: alexander-hernandez

milestones.headline: Local Business Shutdowns & Meatpacking Labor Friction
milestones.description: Local broadcast affiliate KSN-TV reports widespread grocery and restaurant closures as workforce stays home in solidarity.
milestones.author: ksn-tv

milestones.headline: Cattle & Meatpacking Supply Chain Warning
milestones.description: TikTok creator warns that continued agricultural and packing plant raids will trigger regional food distribution crisis.
milestones.author: doris-medrano40
